what_i_see: An isometric 3D tree with an orange/yellow rectangular trunk and base, topped with a layered green canopy made of stacked boxes forming a tiered conical shape. The green foliage has a rounded sphere-like element behind the blocky layers, giving it a stylized low-poly tree appearance. Clear tree silhouette, good color choices with green canopy and warm trunk, though the construction is fairly standard voxel-style.
